results.title: A channel failing for a week, then recovering
results.evidence: 30 failure(s) recorded and summarised, and recovery sends — all correct. What is not: `_deliver` calls `transport.send` outside any try, and the contract that makes that safe is that a channel reports rather than raises. `WebhookChannel.send` calls `permit(self.url)` BEFORE its own try, so an operator who pastes a `file:` URL — the case the comment beside it names — raises out of `send`, out of `_
